svg.title: Measured speedups from the portability and interop campaign
svg.desc: Horizontal bars on a log scale. CPU pip wheel with oneTBB: simplify, 1M terms (M4 Pro): 5.57x; CPU pip wheel with oneTBB: simplify, 1M terms (EPYC, 16 vCPU): 2.15x; CUDA Hand 1M-term operator to CuPy (zero copy vs via host): 244x; CUDA Build operator from CuPy arrays, 1M terms (vs via host): 247x; CUDA Fused small simplify, 128 terms: 7.80x; CUDA Pooled commutation output, 128 x 128 (sole cudaMalloc buffer): 6.06x; HIP Single-term simplify: 8.22x; HIP Fused small simplify, 128 terms: 5.68x; Metal Precompiled kernels: first simplify call: 1.26x; Metal Parallel reduction: hybrid simplify, 4M unique terms: 1.12x
svg.text: What the portability and interop campaign changed
Speedup of each new path over the one it replaced: medians at one named boundary per row. Log scale.

svg.text: Hosts: NVIDIA H100, AMD MI300X, Apple M4 Pro, AMD EPYC 9654 VM. Each row's report in docs/benchmarks/reports/ has the boundary, commands and spread.
Rows are not comparable with each other: they measure different operations, sizes and hardware.
